analysis.title: Leidos Holdings (LDOS): 3Q26 First Take: Mixed results; 2026 guidance updated
key_insights: LDOS 3Q26 revenue of $4.63bn (up 1% organically, 4% total) is 2% below FactSet consensus. Adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS and free cash flow are all ahead of consensus.

Adjusted EPS of $3.62 compares with FactSet consensus of $3.03. A much lower tax rate contributed: the effective rate was 15.1% against the GS estimate of 24.5%, worth $0.40 of the $0.58 EPS variance vs the GS estimate.
Total EBITDA is $644mn, 5% ahead of consensus, on a 13.9% margin that is 100bps above the GS estimate. Margins are ahead of consensus in three of four segments.
Segment operating profit of $634mn is 8% above the GS estimate. Homeland beat by 26.8% and Intelligence & Digital by 12.2%, while Defense missed by 12.5%.
Health revenue fell 11.7% yoy to $1,068mn and its margin dropped 450bps yoy to 22.8%. Homeland revenue grew 32.1% yoy to $1,024mn.
Funded book-to-bill is 1.18X (1.11X on a TTM basis). Company-reported book-to-bill is 1.2X (1.1X TTM). Total backlog is up 2% qoq and up 4% yoy.
Reported free cash flow of $476mn is well above consensus of $283mn.

2026 guidance update: revenue cut by $200mn at both ends to $18.0-$18.2bn (below the $18.3bn consensus). Adjusted EPS raised to $12.50-$12.70 (consensus $12.40). Adjusted EBITDA margin reiterated at mid 13% (consensus 13.4%). CFO raised to ~$1.90bn (consensus ~$1.95bn).
The guidance combines lower revenue, reiterated margins and a lower tax rate. The EPS raise is therefore not driven by higher sales.
GS keeps a Neutral rating and a $127 12-month price target, based on 8.7X Q5-Q8 EV/EBITDA. Against the $144.16 close on 2 Nov, that implies 11.9% downside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and the $127 target after the 3Q26 print, which implies 11.9% downside from $144.16. The EPS and cash flow beat is paired with a revenue miss and a lower 2026 revenue guide.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted diluted EPS reported at $3.62 vs FactSet consensus est $3.03 and 3Q25 adjusted EPS of $3.05 (+18.4% yoy).
3Q26 revenue reported at $4.63bn vs FactSet consensus (2% above the print). Organic growth was 1% yoy and total growth 4%.
3Q26 total adjusted EBITDA reported at $644mn on a 13.9% margin, 5% ahead of FactSet consensus and 100bps above the GS estimate of 12.9%.
3Q26 reported free cash flow of $476mn vs consensus est $283mn.

2026 guidance as updated 3 Nov: revenue $18.0-$18.2bn (prior $18.2-$18.4bn, consensus est $18.3bn), adjusted EPS $12.50-$12.70 (prior $12.20-$12.50, consensus est $12.40), adjusted EBITDA margin mid 13% reiterated (consensus est 13.4%), CFO ~$1.90bn (prior ~$1.85bn, consensus est ~$1.95bn).
GS forecasts for LDOS: FY2026E revenue $18,319.7mn, EBITDA $2,463.2mn and EPS $12.40. Quarterly EPS estimates are 4Q26E $2.97 and 1Q27E $2.72 (pre-print GS estimates).
